(async()=>{const {useStudio}=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const {demonstration}=await import('/src/studio/architect/model.ts');const {architectKey}=await import('/src/studio/architect/persistence.ts');const id=useStudio.getState().job.id;const fixture=demonstration(id);fixture.name='Synthetic retained opening QA';const wall=fixture.walls[0];wall.a=[0,0];wall.b=[4000,0];wall.height=2700;wall.layers=[{...wall.layers[0],kind:'solid',thickness:200,name:'Declared QA solid'}];fixture.walls=[wall];const opening=fixture.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='window');opening.wallId=wall.id;opening.offset=1000;opening.width=900;opening.height=2100;opening.sill=300;wall.lifecycle={status:'existing',reference:'Synthetic survey'};opening.lifecycle={status:'demolished',reference:'Synthetic removal brief'};fixture.openings=[opening];fixture.slabs=[];fixture.roofs=[];fixture.lines=[];fixture.circles=[];fixture.arcs=[];fixture.dimensions=[];fixture.roomTags=[];fixture.grids=[];localStorage.setItem(architectKey(id),JSON.stringify(fixture));window.qaKey=architectKey(id);window.qaErrors=[];addEventListener('error',e=>qaErrors.push(e.message));addEventListener('unhandledrejection',e=>qaErrors.push(String(e.reason)));useStudio.getState().setSkin('navy');useStudio.getState().setPane('sketch');return {jobId:id,synthetic:true}})()
